newsitem.title: USA: TENNIS-START OF MEN'S FINAL AT U.S. OPEN DELAYED BY RAIN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-START OF MEN'S FINAL AT U.S. OPEN DELAYED BY RAIN.

text.p: The start of Sunday's U.S. Open men's final between top-seeded defending champion Pete Sampras and second seed Michael Chang was being delayed by rain.
A thunderstorm brought torrential rain just as Steffi Graf completed a 7-5 6-4 victory over Monica Seles to successfully defend her title in the women's final on Stadium Court.
Skies were brightening in the distance, however, revealing again the Manhattan skyline and giving reasonable hope that the rain would subside and allow the playing of the men's final.
